An '''ocular printer''' recorded the patterns of a being's eyes. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] used a genetically modified form of [[Bledsoe's disease]] to cause discolorations in a being's eyes that acted as star charts, revealing hidden [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] bases. [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Kaaldar]] of the [[Imperial garrison base]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] used an ocular printer to record these patterns. According to Kaaldar, the process requires that the eyes are open long enough to record the star chart, and was both painless and very quick.<ref name="TS" />
